description:
Slice text by head/tail lines or an inclusive line range.

  Args:
  - `text` or `path` — subject (exactly one)
  - `head` — first N lines
  - `tail` — last N lines
  - `start_line` / `end_line` — inclusive 1-based range

  Prefer one mode: `head`, `tail`, or `start_line`(+optional `end_line`).
